faqs.q: What is Ferryl Ferrycid rust remover used for?
faqs.a: Ferryl Ferrycid is a water-dilutable rust remover and cleaner for heavy rust, rust scale and rust stains on paintwork. It also removes limescale, cement and dirt from wooden decks and sanitary installations. It is diluted with water to suit how bad the rust is.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Ferrycid come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Ferrycid comes in a 25 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-FERRYCID-25L), a 10 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-FERRYCID-10L) and a 1 L plastic bottle (IH-FRY-FERRYCID-1L). Pick the pack by the size of the job: a bottle for spot work, a drum for decks or a bath.

faqs.q: Ferryl Ferrycid rust remover or Ferryl Fermaid alkaline cleaner for a rusty deck?
faqs.a: Ferrycid is the rust remover: Ferryl states it reacts with the rust, not the steel. Fermaid is a water-based alkaline degreaser for dirt, oil and grease, and Ferryl does not describe it as a rust remover. Use Ferrycid for rust and [Ferryl Fermaid](/p/ferryl-fermaid-alkaline-cleaning-liquid) for greasy decks.

faqs.q: How should I dilute Ferryl Ferrycid for light or heavy rust?
faqs.a: Ferryl says to dilute Ferrycid with water according to how severe the rust is. It acts quickly on light rust and, given time, removes heavy rust completely. Ferryl does not publish fixed dilution ratios or contact times in the product data we hold, so describe the rust to us if you want advice.

faqs.q: How well does Ferryl Ferrycid remove heavy rust and rust scale?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that Ferrycid acts quickly on light rust and, given time, removes heavy rust completely; badly corroded parts can be left in a Ferrycid bath. On heavy rust it leaves an inert white powder that is brushed or rinsed away before coating. No treatment time is published.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Ferrycid rust remover safe on painted surfaces, wood and plastic?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists iron and steel, painted surfaces, wood, ceramic, plastic, vinyl and glass as surfaces for Ferrycid. Applied early to rust stains on paintwork, Ferryl states it removes the stain without fading the paint and leaves a thin protective layer. Rinse with fresh water afterwards.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Ferrycid have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Ferrycid. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ferryl advises wearing suitable gloves and eye protection when using it.

faqs.q: What goes on after Ferryl Ferrycid to protect cleaned steel or paintwork?
faqs.a: Ferryl suggests protecting cleaned stainless steel with Ferryl 401 and cleaned spare parts with Ferryl 103 drying oil. After rinsing, a stained painted surface can be touched up or repainted with no further treatment. See the [anticorrosive and safety coatings](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings) shelf.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Ferrycid rust remover?
faqs.a: Apply Ferrycid by brush, rag, mop, spray, pouring, pressure washer or submersion, then rinse with fresh water. Wear suitable gloves and eye protection. On heavy rust, brush or rinse off the white powder it leaves before any coating goes on.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Ferrycid used on board and ashore?
faqs.a: Ferrycid is used on heavy rust and scale, rust stains on paintwork, limescale and cement deposits, wooden outer decks and sanitary installations. Corroded parts can be bath-soaked in it. Browse the full [marine maintenance chemicals](/c/marine-maintenance-chemicals) shelf for related products.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Ferrycid and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Ferrycid is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Ferrycid in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl Ferrycid Rust Remover in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the order.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Rustoil penetrating oil?
faqs.a: Ferryl Rustoil is a very thin oil that creeps into threads, joints and the core of a wire rope. It loosens rust, dried oil and old grease, displaces water and moisture, lubricates, and leaves a thin film that holds off fresh rust.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Rustoil come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Rustoil comes in a 10 L metal can (IH-FRY-RUSTOIL-10L) and a 450 ml aerosol (IH-FRY-RUSTOIL-450ML-AER). Both are listed as ex-stock items.

faqs.q: Ferryl Rustoil penetrating oil or Ferryl Ferrycid rust remover for rusty fixings?
faqs.a: Rustoil is a thin oil that creeps into threads and frees seized parts, leaving a thin protective film. Ferrycid is a water-diluted rust remover that reacts with rust and leaves heavy rust as a white powder to rinse off. Use Rustoil to free a bolt; use [Ferryl Ferrycid](/p/ferryl-ferrycid-rust-remover) to clear rust from a surface.

faqs.q: Should I buy the 10 L can or the 450 ml aerosol of Ferryl Rustoil?
faqs.a: Both packs are applied by spray, rag, brush, pouring or submersion according to the listing. The 450 ml aerosol is the pack for spraying individual bolts, hinges and locks. The 10 L metal can is the pack to pour, brush or wipe over many parts or a length of wire rope.

faqs.q: What does Ferryl Rustoil do on rusted or seized parts?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists these properties: it penetrates easily, loosens rust, oil and grease, displaces water and moisture, lubricates and protects against rust. Ferryl does not publish a penetration time, viscosity or base-oil type, so we do not quote one.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Rustoil safe on painted surfaces and near electrics?
faqs.a: Ferryl describes Rustoil as non-corrosive and non-conductive and safe on all metals and painted surfaces. It is a thin penetrating oil; Ferryl does not publish the base oil. It leaves a thin oily film, so wipe it off any surface that has to stay dry.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Rustoil have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Rustoil. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the sheet before use if your site requires one on file.

faqs.q: What follows Ferryl Rustoil when I prepare used wire rope?
faqs.a: After Rustoil has dissolved old grease and driven moisture out of the core, the new coat of Ferryl 101 oil or Ferryl 202 grease does not seal rust and water in. See the [wire rope anticorrosive greases](/c/wire-rope-anticorrosive-greases) shelf and the guide on [wire rope construction](/blog/wire-rope-construction-explained).

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Rustoil to seized bolts or old wire rope?
faqs.a: Spray, pour, brush, wipe or dip the part in Rustoil. For used or rusty wire rope, brush or wipe it on so it dissolves old grease, loosens rust and drives moisture out of the core before the rope is re-greased.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Rustoil used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists screws and bolts, shackles, chains and lashings, latches, locks, hinges, springs, valves, wheels and machine parts, plus cleaning used wire rope before re-greasing. The wider range is on the [marine maintenance chemicals](/c/marine-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Rustoil and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Rustoil is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Rustoil in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl Rustoil Penetrating Oil in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the order.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid oil and grease remover?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cleaning Fluid is the heavy degreaser of the Ferryl range. It is solvent-based and emulsifies with water, so it dissolves oil and grease and then rinses away. It is non-chlorinated and supplied in a 25 litre metal drum.

faqs.q: What pack size and part number is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cleaning Fluid comes in one pack, a 25 L metal drum, part number IH-FRY-CF-25L. No smaller size is listed. It is ex-stock.

faqs.q: Ferryl Cleaning Fluid solvent degreaser or Ferryl Fermaid water-based cleaner?
faqs.a: Cleaning Fluid is solvent-based and aimed at heavy oil and grease. Fermaid is a water-based alkaline concentrate for general degreasing that also has a disinfecting, deodorising effect. Choose Cleaning Fluid for heavy oil, and [Ferryl Fermaid](/p/ferryl-fermaid-alkaline-cleaning-liquid) for galleys and general degreasing.

faqs.q: When is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid the right degreaser for an engine room?
faqs.a: Choose Cleaning Fluid when the soil is fuel, lube or diesel oil, grease, soot, carbon, asphalt or wax on decks, machinery, engine rooms, cargo holds or tanks. For live electrical equipment use [Ferryl Electroclean](/p/ferryl-electroclean-electrical-equipment-cleaner) instead.

faqs.q: What oils and soils does Ferryl Cleaning Fluid remove?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists fuel oil, lube oil and diesel, mineral oils, grease and fats, dirt, soot, carbon, asphalt and wax. Ferryl states the cleaning is fast and powerful on all types of oil and grease. No cleaning time or dilution ratio is published.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid safe on metals, paint and plastics?
faqs.a: Ferryl describes Cleaning Fluid as non-corrosive and safe on all metals, painted surfaces and most plastics, and it is non-chlorinated. Because it is a solvent, test a small hidden area on any plastic you are unsure about.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Cleaning Fluid have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Cleaning Fluid. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the sheet before use in an enclosed space.

faqs.q: Can Ferryl Cleaning Fluid remove Ferryl 103 drying oil from spare parts?
faqs.a: Yes. Ferryl names Cleaning Fluid as the way to take Ferryl 103 drying oil off a spare part when it goes back into service. Ferryl Electroclean also removes it from stored parts.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Cleaning Fluid?
faqs.a: Apply Cleaning Fluid by rag, brush, spray, mop, sponge or submersion, then rinse, since it emulsifies with water. Ferryl publishes no fixed dilution or contact time.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists decks, machinery, engine rooms, cargo holds and tanks, and the removal of Ferryl 103 drying oil from spare parts. The other cleaners are on the [ship maintenance chemicals](/c/ship-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Cleaning Fluid and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cleaning Fluid is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Cleaning Fluid in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl Cleaning Fluid Oil & Grease Remover in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the order.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Electroclean electrical equipment cleaner?
faqs.a: Ferryl Electroclean is a non-conductive, high-flashpoint solvent cleaner for motors, generators, switchgear, relays and contacts. It dissolves oil, grease and dirt and evaporates quickly to leave a clean, dry, film-free surface.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Electroclean come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Electroclean comes in a 25 L metal drum (IH-FRY-EC-25L) and a 450 ml aerosol (IH-FRY-EC-450ML-AER). Both are ex-stock.

faqs.q: Ferryl Electroclean or Ferryl Cleaning Fluid for oily electrical equipment?
faqs.a: Electroclean is non-conductive, high-flashpoint and leaves no film, so it is the one made for electrical equipment. Cleaning Fluid is the heavy solvent degreaser for decks, machinery and tanks. Use Electroclean on motors and switchgear and [Ferryl Cleaning Fluid](/p/ferryl-cleaning-fluid-oil-grease-remover) on heavy oil.

faqs.q: Should I buy Ferryl Electroclean in the drum or the aerosol?
faqs.a: The 450 ml aerosol is the pack for spraying contacts, relays and small parts. The 25 L metal drum is the pack for rags, brushes and submersion of larger parts or many items. Both carry the same product.

faqs.q: What cleaning properties does Ferryl Electroclean have?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists non-conductive, strong dissolving power for oil, grease and dirt, high flashpoint, penetration of small parts and narrow gaps, and quick evaporation without a residue film. No flashpoint figure or evaporation time is published.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Electroclean safe on metals, paint and varnish?
faqs.a: Ferryl describes Electroclean as non-corrosive and safe on all metals and alloys and on most painted or varnished surfaces. It is non-chlorinated. Test a hidden spot on delicate paint or varnish before wiping a whole surface.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Electroclean have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Electroclean. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ferryl advises isolating equipment before cleaning.

faqs.q: What else cleans stored parts coated in Ferryl 103 drying oil?
faqs.a: Like Cleaning Fluid, Electroclean removes Ferryl 103 drying oil from stored parts. For other oily surfaces such as decks and engine rooms, [Ferryl Cleaning Fluid](/p/ferryl-cleaning-fluid-oil-grease-remover) is the heavy degreaser in the range.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Electroclean safely?
faqs.a: Apply Electroclean by rag, brush, spray or submersion. Isolate the equipment before cleaning, as Ferryl advises, and let it evaporate to a dry, film-free surface.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Electroclean used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists motors and generators, switchgear, switches and relays, contacts and coils, electronics, alarms, electrical cables and compressors. See the [ship maintenance chemicals](/c/ship-maintenance-chemicals) shelf for the other cleaners.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Electroclean and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Electroclean is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Electroclean in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl Electroclean Electrical Equipment Cleaner in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the order.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Fermaid alkaline cleaning liquid?
faqs.a: Ferryl Fermaid is a water-based alkaline concentrate for cleaning and degreasing. Diluted with water, it removes dirt, oil and grease, has a disinfecting and deodorising effect and leaves a pleasant scent.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Fermaid come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Fermaid comes in a 25 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-FERMAID-25L), a 10 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-FERMAID-10L) and a 1 L plastic bottle (IH-FRY-FERMAID-1L). All three are ex-stock.

faqs.q: Ferryl Fermaid water-based cleaner or Ferryl Cleaning Fluid solvent degreaser?
faqs.a: Fermaid is a water-based alkaline concentrate for general degreasing. Cleaning Fluid is solvent-based and is the choice for heavy oil and grease. Use Fermaid on galleys, floors and refrigerated holds, and [Ferryl Cleaning Fluid](/p/ferryl-cleaning-fluid-oil-grease-remover) on heavy oil.

faqs.q: Ferryl Fermaid or Ferryl Cabin Clean for deck and accommodation cleaning?
faqs.a: Fermaid is the alkaline degreasing concentrate for decks, galleys, refrigerated holds and engine department floors. [Ferryl Cabin Clean](/p/ferryl-cabin-clean-general-cleaning-liquid) is the pH-neutral concentrate for light indoor cleaning in cabins and the bridge. Ferryl points to Cabin Clean for light indoor work.

faqs.q: What does Ferryl Fermaid alkaline cleaner remove?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists dirt, oil and grease, and states a disinfecting and deodorising effect. Ferryl does not publish a pH figure, dilution ratio or a list of tested soils, so we do not quote one.

faqs.q: Can Ferryl Fermaid be used on any surface?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists Fermaid as suitable for virtually any surface, including decks, floors, equipment, tools, refrigerators, containers, sanitary installations, windows and portholes. As an alkaline product, test a hidden area on delicate finishes first.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Fermaid have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Fermaid. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the sheet if your galley or catering audit needs one.

faqs.q: What other Ferryl cleaner goes with Ferryl Fermaid for odours?
faqs.a: Fermaid already has a deodorising effect. For spaces and cargo holds where the smell comes from airborne bacteria and particles, add [Ferryl Air-Refreshment](/p/ferryl-air-refreshment-odour-neutraliser), which is a non-flammable odour neutraliser sprayed into the air.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Fermaid?
faqs.a: Dilute Fermaid with water, then apply by mop, rag, sponge, brush, submersion or pressure washer. It is sold as a concentrate. No fixed dilution ratio is published, so ask us if you need a starting point.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Fermaid used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists decks, floors and equipment, the engine department, tools, catering departments, galleys and pantries, refrigerated holds, containers and chambers, sanitary installations, windows and portholes, and fishing vessels.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Fermaid and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Fermaid is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Fermaid in stock and how do I order it?

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Cabin Clean general cleaning liquid?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cabin Clean is a pH-neutral, water-based cleaning concentrate for indoor cleaning on board. It removes dirt and light grease and is intended for cabins, mess rooms, the bridge, bathrooms, floors, stairs and windows.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Cabin Clean come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cabin Clean comes in a 25 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-CABIN-25L) and a 10 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-CABIN-10L). Both are ex-stock.

faqs.q: Ferryl Cabin Clean or Ferryl Fermaid for everyday cleaning on a ship?
faqs.a: Cabin Clean is the pH-neutral everyday cleaner for light dirt and light grease indoors. Fermaid is an alkaline concentrate for heavier degreasing in galleys, decks and the engine department. Use Cabin Clean for accommodation and [Ferryl Fermaid](/p/ferryl-fermaid-alkaline-cleaning-liquid) for greasier areas.

faqs.q: When should I choose Ferryl Cabin Clean instead of a degreaser?
faqs.a: Choose Cabin Clean for routine indoor cleaning where the soil is dirt and light grease. For heavy oil and grease, [Ferryl Cleaning Fluid](/p/ferryl-cleaning-fluid-oil-grease-remover) is the solvent degreaser in the range. Cabin Clean is for indoor use only.

faqs.q: How well does Ferryl Cabin Clean remove grease?
faqs.a: Ferryl states Cabin Clean removes dirt and light grease; it does not present it as a heavy degreaser. Ferryl publishes no pH figure, dilution ratio or cleaning time for it, so we do not quote one.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Cabin Clean safe on indoor surfaces?
faqs.a: Ferryl describes Cabin Clean as pH neutral and safe on virtually any indoor surface, including floors, stairs, bathrooms and sanitary installations, windows and portholes. It is intended for indoor use only.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Cabin Clean have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Cabin Clean. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request.

faqs.q: What other Ferryl product tackles smells in cabins alongside Ferryl Cabin Clean?
faqs.a: Cabin Clean cleans the surfaces. For bad odours in cabins, bathrooms and galleys, [Ferryl Air-Refreshment](/p/ferryl-air-refreshment-odour-neutraliser) is a non-flammable odour neutraliser that is sprayed into the air.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Cabin Clean?
faqs.a: Dilute Cabin Clean with water, then apply by mop, rag, sponge, brush or submersion. It is intended for indoor use. No fixed dilution ratio is published.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Cabin Clean used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists cabins, mess rooms, the bridge, corridors and stairs, floors, bathrooms and sanitary installations, and windows and portholes. More cleaners are on the [ship maintenance chemicals](/c/ship-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Cabin Clean and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Cabin Clean is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Cabin Clean in stock and how do I order it?

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Air-Refreshment bad odour neutraliser?
faqs.a: Ferryl Air-Refreshment is a non-flammable liquid odour neutraliser. It is chemically active against the bacteria and airborne particles behind bad smells, so the smell is removed rather than masked, leaving a fresh, neutral scent.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Air-Refreshment come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Air-Refreshment comes in a 25 L plastic drum (IH-FRY-AIR-25L), a 500 ml spray bottle (IH-FRY-AIR-500ML-SPR) and a pack of 10 spray bottles (IH-FRY-AIR-500ML-SPR-X10). All are ex-stock.

faqs.q: Ferryl Air-Refreshment odour neutraliser or an ordinary air freshener in a cargo hold?
faqs.a: An ordinary air freshener covers a smell with a stronger one, and in a hold that can taint the next cargo. Air-Refreshment acts on the bacteria and particles that cause the odour and leaves a neutral scent. Ferryl describes it as removing the smell rather than masking it.

faqs.q: Should I buy Ferryl Air-Refreshment in the 25 L drum or the 500 ml spray bottle?
faqs.a: The 25 L drum is for spraying holds and large spaces with spraying equipment. The 500 ml non-aerosol hand-pump bottle is for small spaces such as cabins, bathrooms and toilets, and comes singly or in packs of 10.

faqs.q: What odours does Ferryl Air-Refreshment deal with?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists fish and animal smells, waste, cigarette smoke and mildew. It is non-flammable and supplied as a non-aerosol spray bottle in the small pack. Ferryl does not publish a duration of effect, so we do not quote one.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Air-Refreshment safe for cargo holds and containers?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists cargo holds and containers after odorous cargoes among its uses and describes the scent as fresh and neutral, so it is aimed at not tainting the next cargo. It is applied as a spray into the air, not onto cargo.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Air-Refreshment have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Air-Refreshment. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the sheet if your cargo or catering audit needs one.

faqs.q: What should I use with Ferryl Air-Refreshment to clean the source of the smell?
faqs.a: Air-Refreshment treats the air. Clean the surfaces too: [Ferryl Fermaid](/p/ferryl-fermaid-alkaline-cleaning-liquid) for galleys, refrigerated holds and floors, or [Ferryl Cabin Clean](/p/ferryl-cabin-clean-general-cleaning-liquid) for cabins and bathrooms.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Air-Refreshment?
faqs.a: Spray it evenly into the air. Use spraying equipment in holds and large spaces, or the hand-pump bottle in small ones. It is a liquid sprayer, not an aerosol.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Air-Refreshment used on board?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists cargo holds and containers, storage rooms, processing facilities and factories, garbage-disposal areas, galleys, mess rooms, cabins, bathrooms and toilets, the bridge and fishing vessels. See the [ship maintenance chemicals](/c/ship-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Air-Refreshment and where is it made?

faqs.q: What is Ferryl Armacit pipe thread sealant?
faqs.a: Ferryl Armacit is a viscous black paste applied to threaded and flanged pipe joints before assembly. It fills voids and gaps, then sets hard into a permanent, air-tight packing that does not work loose under vibration.

faqs.q: Which pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl Armacit come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl Armacit comes in a 150 g plastic tube (IH-FRY-ARMACIT-150G) and a pack of 12 tubes (IH-FRY-ARMACIT-150G-X12). Both are ex-stock.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Armacit a hard-setting sealant or one for joints taken apart often?
faqs.a: Armacit sets hard, so it is meant for permanently fitted systems rather than joints that are taken apart often. Among the other Ferryl maintenance chemicals, products such as [Ferryl Rustoil](/p/ferryl-rustoil-penetrating-oil) free parts and clean, whereas Armacit only seals.

faqs.q: Which piping systems is Ferryl Armacit pipe thread sealant chosen for?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists steam, fire-fighting water, compressed air, hydraulic, sewage and fuel lines. Choose it for permanent threaded or flanged joints in these systems, and not for joints that must be opened regularly.

faqs.q: How well does Ferryl Armacit resist pressure, water, oil and chemicals?
faqs.a: Ferryl states Armacit holds up to the burst pressure of most piping systems and resists water, steam, oil, petrol, many solvents, acids and diluted alkalis. Ferryl publishes no pressure or temperature figure, only that it works over a wide temperature range.

faqs.q: Which pipe materials can Ferryl Armacit be used on?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists steel and galvanised steel, stainless steel, brass, aluminium and PVC. It is a black paste applied to threads or flange faces before assembly and is ready to use from the tube.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl Armacit have approvals or a safety data sheet?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for Armacit. The documents available are the product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the sheet if the fuel or fire-fighting system needs documentation.

faqs.q: What other Ferryl maintenance chemicals go with Ferryl Armacit?
faqs.a: Armacit seals joints; the rest of the range cleans or frees parts. [Ferryl Cleaning Fluid](/p/ferryl-cleaning-fluid-oil-grease-remover) removes oil and grease from machinery, and the full set is on the [marine maintenance chemicals](/c/marine-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: How do I apply Ferryl Armacit to a threaded or flanged joint?
faqs.a: Apply Armacit to the threads or flange faces before assembly, straight from the tube. It fills voids and gaps, then sets hard. Ferryl publishes no cure time, so allow for it before pressurising a system.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl Armacit used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists permanently fitted threaded and flanged connections in steam, fire-fighting water, compressed air, hydraulic, sewage and fuel piping. See the [ship maintenance chemicals](/c/ship-maintenance-chemicals) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl Armacit and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl Armacit is made by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH in Germany, the stated country of origin, and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl Armacit in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl Armacit Pipe Thread Sealant in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the order.
